title: Custom-race wizard control inventory and selection model

provenance.note: Static dialog templates and Win16 control styles.

provenance.location: TOPICPOS 1690878 (0x0019ccfe), HLP file offset 428787 (0x00068af3), topic 247 'Custom Race Wizard'

setup.baseline: Binary inspection of the supplied executable; no execution required for static findings.
setup.variable: Decode control class/style/caption for dialogs #146-#151 and #209.

procedure: Parse each dialog template with the PR1 checked parser.
List controls, captions, IDs and Win16 style bits.
Classify selection controls as auto-radio, auto-checkbox or other by style low word.
Compare candidate wizard dialogs with exported RACEWIZARDDLG1-6 names without assuming an ID mapping.

static: #149 contains ten BS_AUTORADIOBUTTON controls with captions naming all ten primary traits; control 271 starts the group, so the dialog statically permits at most one selected primary trait. Exactly one is the PR5 product requirement; original required-selection behavior is unverified.
#150 contains fourteen BS_AUTOCHECKBOX controls with empty captions; independent checkboxes statically permit zero or more lesser selections, but their trait mapping is unresolved.
#151 contains six independent three-choice radio groups (18 controls) for research-cost choices, plus one auto-checkbox for the all-fields starting-tech option.
#146-#151 are contiguous wizard-style dialogs; #209 is the New Game dialog with Customize Race and Advanced Game controls.
Control styles are static evidence only; the runtime path from these dialogs to the race model is not established.

unresolved: The mapping of exported RACEWIZARDDLG1-6 to #146-#151 is unresolved.
The 14 lesser-trait checkbox positions are not yet mapped to trait identities.
Whether any radio/check style is changed at runtime is unknown.
notes: This scenario is statically derived from dialog templates; it is not an original-game observation.
